faq.q: What are adrenal fatigue supplements?
faq.a: You may have seen the term 'adrenal fatigue' before, but it isn’t validated by scientific evidence. What is well-documented is the very real physical and mental toll that chronic, ongoing stress can take on the body, leaving you feeling persistently overwhelmed and depleted. Adrenal fatigue supplements typically refer to supplements formulated to support the body's response to stress and stress-related fatigue. Adreset® falls into this category, and it features three clinically studied adaptogenic herbs that research suggests may help the body adapt to stress and support stamina.*

faq.q: How do adaptogen supplements work?
faq.a: Adaptogens, such as ashwagandha, holy basil and reishi mushroom, have been used across traditional medicine systems for centuries, from Ayurveda to Traditional Chinese Medicine. Research suggests they may help the body respond to physical and mental demands, supporting resilience during periods of stress.* Adreset® features three well-researched adaptogens—rhodiola, panax ginseng and cordyceps—each with its own traditional use history and body of research supporting their role in stress resilience and stamina.*

faq.q: How should I take Adreset® for best results?
faq.a: Take two capsules twice daily, or as directed by your healthcare practitioner. For best results, follow the recommended dosage consistently as part of your daily routine. For adults managing everyday stress, supplementation works best as part of a broader wellness routine. Practices like mindfulness and stress management techniques can complement a supplement regimen and support a more balanced response to daily stress.*

faq.q: What does a CoQ10 supplement do for your body?
faq.a: A CoQ10 supplement helps support cellular energy production by aiding in the creation of ATP, the energy your cells use every day. It also acts as an antioxidant, helping protect cells from oxidative stress while supporting overall heart health.

faq.q: Who should consider taking a CoQ10 100 mg supplement?
faq.a: Adults looking to support daily energy levels, heart health, and overall cellular function may benefit from a CoQ10 supplement. It’s especially popular among individuals focused on healthy aging or those wanting additional antioxidant support as part of their wellness routine.

faq.q: What is the difference between ubiquinone and ubiquinol CoQ10?
faq.a: Ubiquinone is the classic, stable form of CoQ10 used in many high-quality supplements, including those from Metagenics. Once in the body, it is naturally converted into ubiquinol, the active form that supports energy production and antioxidant activity.

faq.q: How does CoQ10 support heart health and blood pressure?
faq.a: CoQ10 plays a key role in helping the heart produce energy efficiently, which is essential for proper function. It also supports antioxidant defenses and may help maintain healthy blood pressure levels already within the normal range.

description.text: Benefits of Endura Electrolyte Powder

When you sweat, you lose more than water. You lose the electrolytes your muscles and nervous system need to keep working right. Endura® Electrolyte Powder is an electrolyte powder built to help you rehydrate faster and more completely than water alone, with sodium, potassium, and magnesium to replace what sweat takes out.*

Each packet also brings a full B-vitamin lineup and vitamin C along for the ride, plus taurine and L-alanyl-L-glutamine, an amino acid pairing used in sports nutrition to support recovery.* It’s a good fit whether you’re training for a race, working outside in the heat, or just trying to stay ahead of dehydration on a busy day, including if you’re adjusting to a GLP-1 medication and want extra support keeping your electrolytes balanced.*
What Are Electrolyte Packets

Electrolyte packets are single-serving pouches of powdered minerals, like sodium, potassium, and magnesium, that you mix into water to help your body absorb fluid more effectively than plain water alone. Because electrolytes carry an electric charge, they help pull water into your cells and keep your muscles and nervous system firing the way they should.* Endura® Electrolyte Powder comes as convenient electrolyte powder packets you can toss in a gym bag or glovebox, so you’re not stuck choosing between plain water and a sports drink loaded with added sugar. These electrolyte packs travel easily, whether that’s a gym bag, a desk drawer, or a race-day vest.

Not all hydration is created equal, water matters too. If you’ve ever wondered how tap, filtered, and mineral water stack up, it’s worth understanding what you’re mixing your electrolytes into in the first place.
The Science Inside

Sodium and potassium are the two electrolytes most responsible for fluid balance, working together to move water in and out of your cells and help your muscles contract properly.* Endura® Electrolyte Powder delivers 180 mg of sodium and 100 mg of potassium per packet, along with 150 mg of magnesium, a mineral that plays a role in hundreds of bodily processes, from muscle and nerve function to energy production.*

Magnesium is also one of several nutrients tied to muscle cramping, so if cramps have been an issue for you during or after exercise, it’s worth looking at what else might be behind them.* Rounding out the formula are chromium, calcium, phosphorus, vitamin E, and malic acid, ingredients often included in sports nutrition formulas to support energy metabolism and recovery.*

Every packet of Endura® Electrolyte Powder is built on a full electrolyte and nutrient profile, not just sodium and potassium. Here’s what’s in each serving and why it’s there (see the Nutrient Profile table at the end of this deck for the full breakdown).
It’s also non-GMO, gluten-free, vegetarian, and sweetened with stevia leaf extract instead of artificial sweeteners or added sugar, so you’re not trading one problem for another.*

faq.q: Who is the Gut Relief Duo designed for?
faq.a: This protocol is ideal for adults with sensitive digestion or frequent loose stools who experience bloating, cramping, or urgency after meals. It’s designed for those seeking gentle, natural support to restore digestive balance and comfort while improving nutrient breakdown and gut regularity.

faq.q: What makes the Gut Relief Duo work better together?
faq.a: These two products address different but connected causes of digestive discomfort, making them more effective together than alone. UltraFlora Acute Care helps rebalance gut bacteria and calm an overactive digestive tract, while SpectraZyme Pan 9x improves the breakdown of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates to reduce gas and irritation that can trigger urgency. By supporting both the microbiome and the digestive process, this combination helps restore comfort more completely and consistently leading to smoother digestion, better nutrient absorption, and faster relief.

faq.q: What benefits can patients expect from the Gut Relief Duo and how soon?
faq.a: Most patients notice less bloating, reduced stool frequency, and a calmer, more comfortable belly within the first 1–4 weeks—some even feel relief within the first week. Over time, digestion becomes smoother, meals feel easier to tolerate, and overall gut balance and comfort steadily improve.

faq.q: How should I take this protocol?
faq.a: Take 1 capsule of SpectraZyme Pancreatic Enzymes Extra Strength with each main meal to support digestion. Take 1 capsule of UltraFlora Acute Care once daily, with or without food—evening is ideal for consistency. Both can be taken together, but consistency matters most. For best results, continue daily for at least 4 weeks, stay well-hydrated, and avoid taking either supplement within two hours of antibiotics.

faq.q: Why do you recommend this protocol in your practice?
faq.a: In my many years of clinical practice, I’ve found this simple combination consistently delivers reliable results. These products address the main drivers of digestive discomfort—imbalanced gut bacteria and incomplete digestion—helping patients experience calmer, more predictable digestion and a noticeable improvement in comfort and confidence

faq.q: How much magnesium citrate should I take per day?

faq.q: What is magnesium citrate best used for?

Its high solubility makes it one of the more bioavailable supplemental forms of magnesium, which means more of what you take is available for the body to use.Magnesium plays a role in over 300 enzymatic processes, touching energy production, muscle activity, nerve signaling, and bone structure. faq.q: How long does magnesium citrate take to work?
faq.a: This depends on what you’re using magnesium citrate for. Magnesium begins absorbing into the bloodstream within a few hours of taking a dose. For benefits tied to consistent magnesium levels such as muscle comfort, energy, and bone structure. faq.q: What vitamins help with magnesium absorption?
faq.a: Vitamin D is the most well-established nutrient partner for magnesium. Vitamin D supports the absorption of both magnesium and calcium in the gut, and the three minerals are involved in several overlapping physiological processes. Vitamin D deficiency can limit how effectively your body uses magnesium, even when intake is adequate. Vitamin B6 also plays a supportive role. It helps transport magnesium into cells where it is needed. Calcium, already included in Metagenics Magnesium Citrate, works alongside magnesium across bone and muscle physiology. Maintaining a balanced intake of these nutrients as part of a complete daily routine supports their combined effectiveness. For comprehensive bone and mineral support, explore Metagenics Bone Builder®.

faq.q: What’s the difference between magnesium citrate and glycinate?
faq.a: Both are highly bioavailable forms of magnesium, but they differ in how they are bound and how the body responds to them. Magnesium citrate is magnesium bound to citric acid. It is well-absorbed and widely used for general daily magnesium support. It can have a mild effect on the digestive system, which some people find useful for regularity. Magnesium glycinate is magnesium bound to the amino acid glycine. Glycine has calming properties, making glycinate a common choice for those focused on relaxation and sleep. It tends to be gentler on the digestive system. The best form depends on your primary wellness goal. faq.q: How does muscle growth work, and what makes muscles grow faster?
faq.a: Muscle growth (also called hypertrophy) happens in three main steps: 1. Challenge the muscle. Strength training creates tiny micro-tears in your muscle fibers. 2. Repair and rebuild. Your body uses protein and amino acids to repair those fibers, making them stronger and thicker over time. 3. Recover and adapt. Energy is replenished (ATP), soreness fades, and your muscles adapt so they can handle more stress in the next workout. What helps muscles grow faster is consistency — regular training, enough high-quality protein, and proper recovery. Supplements like protein, creatine, and magnesium with electrolytes can support this process by giving your body the building blocks to repair, the energy to power through workouts, and the nutrients to bounce back more quickly.

faq.q: What makes the Muscle Gains Bundle different from other muscle building supplements?
faq.a: Most muscle building supplements only focus on one thing—like protein or creatine alone. The Muscle Gains Bundle combines three clinically studied formulas: creatine to power strength and performance, protein to repair and grow, and magnesium with electrolytes to relieve soreness and rehydrate. Together, they support the full cycle of building lean mass and faster recovery.

faq.q: What’s the best way to take the Muscle Gains Bundle?

It delivers 20 g of plant protein, clinically studied creatine, and fast-absorbing magnesium + electrolytes in one refreshing shake. You can also mix them into water or your favorite juice if you prefer. Blend ~30 seconds to ensure powders dissolve smoothly. Add fruits and mix-ins. Blend on high 30–60 seconds until creamy. For best texture: Make ahead and let rest in the fridge during your workout. For best results: Drink within 30 minutes post-workout.

faq.q: Why combine creatine, protein, and magnesium into one post-workout smoothie?
faq.a: Because your muscles need more than just protein to grow. Protein provides the building blocks (amino acids), creatine refuels energy (ATP) so you can push harder, and magnesium helps reduce soreness while restoring hydration. Mixing them all into one convenient smoothie makes it easy to cover every stage of training and recovery.

faq.q: How long until I notice muscle growth?*
faq.a: Results vary, but many people feel improvements within the first few weeks—like faster recovery, less soreness, or more strength in their lifts. Protein and creatine work best when taken daily, since muscle repair and creatine saturation build up over time. Magnesium may help relieve tension and cramps as soon as 30 minutes after a workout. * These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. faq.q: What Is Algae Oil?

It is the primary natural source of the long-chain omega-3 fatty acids EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) and DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) in the ocean food chain. Fish accumulate EPA and DHA by consuming algae. Algae oil simply goes straight to the source. Because it is derived from algae rather than fish, it is suitable for vegetarians and vegans and is free from ocean-borne contaminants like mercury and PCBs. OmegaGenics® Algae Omega-3s uses algal oil from Schizochytrium sp., a marine microalgae cultivated in controlled environments for consistent purity and potency. faq.q: Can you get omega-3 from algae?
faq.a: Yes. Algae is the original source of EPA and DHA in nature. Marine microalgae produce these long-chain omega-3 fatty acids, and fish accumulate them by eating algae throughout the food chain. Algal oil delivers the same preformed EPA and DHA your body needs, without requiring fish as the intermediary. Unlike ALA, the plant-based omega-3 found in flaxseed and walnuts, EPA and DHA from algal oil do not need to be converted by the body, they are ready to use. Algal oil offers several practical advantages: it is suitable for vegetarians, free from fish allergens, contains no ocean-sourced contaminants, and produces no fishy aftertaste. Both are effective when delivered in triglyceride form, which supports strong absorption. faq.q: What’s the main difference between EPA and DHA within the body?
faq.a: EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) and DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) are both long-chain omega-3 fatty acids, but they play different primary roles in the body. EPA is most active in cardiovascular and immune function. It plays a central role in the body’s management of inflammatory pathways and is closely linked to heart health support.* DHA is the dominant structural omega-3 in the brain and retina. It is a key building block of brain cell membranes and is essential for cognitive function and eye health throughout life. It is also particularly important during fetal brain development.* Most research and clinical guidelines recommend getting both together, which is why OmegaGenics® Fish Oil Liquid provides 1,410 mg EPA and 990 mg DHA per serving, in the triglyceride form your body recognizes naturally. Read more: Omega-3 Fatty Acids Benefits Explained.

faq.q: Does OmegaGenics liquid fish oil taste fishy?
faq.a: No. OmegaGenics® Fish Oil Liquid is formulated to have no fishy taste or aftertaste. Fishy smell and taste in omega-3 supplements are primarily caused by oxidation, the breakdown of fats when exposed to air, light, or heat. Lower-quality fish oils with higher oxidation levels tend to taste and smell worse. The molecular distillation process used in OmegaGenics removes impurities and keeps oxidation levels low, resulting in a cleaner-tasting oil. Natural fruit flavors are added to make it even more pleasant to take daily.* Consistency matters with omega-3 supplementation — a supplement that tastes good is one you’ll actually keep taking.

faq.q: Is liquid fish oil better than capsules?
faq.a: Neither is inherently better. The right format depends on what matters most to you. Liquid fish oil offers a higher dose per serving without swallowing multiple softgels, making it a practical choice for anyone who struggles with capsules or wants to maximize their omega-3 intake in a single step. It also tends to be more cost-effective per milligram of EPA and DHA. Softgels and capsules offer convenience, portability, and no taste considerations. They are easier to take on the go and require no refrigeration before opening. OmegaGenics® offers both formats across its lineup. If dose and ease of use are your priorities, the liquid is an efficient option. If you prefer the simplicity of a capsule, explore the OmegaGenics® softgel range. Browse the full OmegaGenics® omega-3 lineup.

faq.q: What to look for when buying omega 3 fish oil?
faq.a: Four things matter most when evaluating an omega-3 supplement: EPA and DHA content: Check the actual milligrams of EPA and DHA per serving — not just total fish oil. These are the active fatty acids. OmegaGenics® Fish Oil Liquid delivers 2,400 mg combined per teaspoon. Form: Triglyceride form is the naturally occurring structure found in fish and is better absorbed than ethyl ester alternatives. Always check the label. Purity testing: Look for products tested for heavy metals, PCBs, and other environmental contaminants. OmegaGenics® is tested for 200 contaminants including plasticizers from microplastics. Freshness: Oxidized fish oil loses potency and tastes worse. Look for products with antioxidant stabilization and low peroxide values. Read our full guide: How to Choose the Best Omega-3 Supplement.

faq.q: Does liquid fish oil need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Before opening, OmegaGenics® Fish Oil Liquid does not require refrigeration. It can be stored in a cool, dry place away from direct light and heat. Once opened, refrigerate and keep tightly closed to slow oxidation and preserve freshness and potency. This is standard practice for any high-quality liquid fish oil. Omega-3 fatty acids are sensitive to heat, light, and air exposure. Refrigerating after opening and using the product within the recommended timeframe helps ensure you’re getting the full potency of every serving.

faq.q: How much liquid omega 3 should I take?
faq.a: The recommended serving for OmegaGenics® Fish Oil Liquid EPA-DHA 2400 mg is one teaspoon (5 mL) once daily with food, or as directed by your healthcare practitioner. One teaspoon provides 1,410 mg EPA, 990 mg DHA, and 2.8 g total omega-3 fatty acid triglycerides. General guidelines from health organizations vary. The American Heart Association recommends consuming two servings of fatty fish per week for cardiovascular health. † One daily serving of OmegaGenics® Fish Oil Liquid exceeds that recommendation. Individual omega-3 needs can vary based on diet, health status, and goals. A healthcare practitioner can help you determine the right dose for your specific situation. Read more: How Much Omega-3 Per Day?

description.text: Why Choose SpectraZyme® Complete

Your body relies on a whole team of enzymes to break down every meal, and when that team is short-staffed, digestion can feel sluggish, bloated, or just off. SpectraZyme® Complete Enzymes is a broad-spectrum digestive enzyme designed to fill in the gaps, pairing acid-stable lipase with three proteases that work across different pH ranges to help you get more out of the proteins, fats, and carbohydrates you eat.* Formerly SpectraZyme® Complete, it’s non-GMO, entirely non-animal derived, and one of the more complete digestive enzymes formulas available, built with GLP-1 users in mind who want extra nutritional support as their eating habits shift.*
What is a digestive enzyme complex?

A digestive enzyme complex is a blend of enzymes, each suited to break down a specific type of food, working together instead of relying on just one. SpectraZyme® Complete Enzymes brings together 11 enzymes, including amylase, protease, lipase, cellulase, and lactase, to support the digestion of proteins, peptides, carbohydrates, fats, cellulose, maltose, lactose, and sucrose in one complete enzymes formula.* Because the three proteases inside are active across different pH levels, they keep working as food moves from the stomach into the small intestine, not just in one narrow window.
The Science Inside

Digestive enzymes are proteins your pancreas and gut naturally produce to break large food molecules into smaller, absorbable pieces, and getting extra support can help when what your body makes doesn’t quite keep pace with what you eat.* SpectraZyme® Complete Enzymes uses non-animal derived enzymes, including amylase (24,000 DU) to break down carbohydrates, a trio of proteases (acid, neutral, and fungal) to break down proteins across a range of stomach and intestinal pH levels, and acid-stable lipase (800 FCCLU) to help digest dietary fats. Xylanase, cellulase, hemicellulase, lactase, pectinase, and invertase round out the enzyme complex, each targeted at a different type of carbohydrate or fiber found in a typical meal.*
What’s Inside (and What’s Not)

Every capsule of SpectraZyme® Complete Enzymes is built from a broad-spectrum, non-animal derived enzyme blend, meaning none of the 11 enzymes come from pig or ox sources like some traditional formulas. It’s also non-GMO and free of synthetic fillers, just capsule (hydroxypropylmethylcellulose), maltodextrin, and medium-chain triglycerides carrying the enzyme blend. One thing to know: the formula does contain milk, wheat, and soy, so it’s not the right fit if you’re managing those allergies.*

faq.q: How does gut health affect sleep?
faq.a: Your gut and brain are in constant communication through the gut-brain axis — a signaling network that connects your digestive system to your central nervous system. When digestion is incomplete or your gut microbiome is out of balance, communication can trigger discomfort, restlessness, and disrupted sleep. Supporting digestion at night helps keep that signaling pathway calm, so your body can focus on rest rather than processing a backlog. * UltraFlora® Night Rest & Digest is formulated specifically to support that connection.

faq.q: Why take digestive enzymes at night instead of during the day?
faq.a: Your body shifts into "rest and digest" mode at night, meaning your parasympathetic nervous system prioritizes internal repair and digestion over external activity. Taking digestive enzymes before bed puts support where your body is already focused — helping break down food from your evening meal so you wake up feeling light and comfortable rather than heavy or bloated. * That's exactly what UltraFlora® Night Rest & Digest is designed to do.

faq.q: What is a postbiotic supplement?
faq.a: Postbiotics are beneficial compounds produced when probiotics break down and ferment food in your gut. Unlike probiotics, which are live bacteria, postbiotics are stable, shelf-ready compounds that support gut barrier function, reduce digestive discomfort, and help maintain a balanced gut environment. * If you’re ready for a postbiotic formula with targeted gut support, UltraFlora® Night Rest & Digest does that without needing to rely on live cultures alone.

faq.q: Can UltraFlora® Night Rest & Digest help with nighttime bloating?
faq.a: Yes. Nighttime bloating is often caused by undigested food fermenting in the gut, producing gas that builds up while you sleep. Digestive enzymes help break down proteins, fats, and carbohydrates more completely before they reach the colon, reducing the fuel available for gas-producing bacteria. * Try it risk-free with our 60-day money-back guarantee.

faq.q: Do digestive enzymes help with sleep?
faq.a: Digestive enzymes don't directly cause sleep, but they can support the conditions that make restful sleep easier. When your body isn't working overtime to process undigested food, you're less likely to experience the nighttime bloating, gas, or discomfort that disrupts sleep. UltraFlora® Night Rest & Digest combines digestive enzymes with botanicals that support the gut-brain axis — the communication network between your digestive system and your brain that influences how well you rest. *

faq.q: Why does Ultra Flora Night Rest and Digest smell unpleasant?
faq.a: Asafetida oleo-gum-resin extract (Asafin®) contains organosulphur compounds, which are bioactive and contribute to gut and microbiome benefits, but also make it naturally pungent. Like garlic, cruciferous vegetables, and sulphur-rich mineral waters, nature's most active compounds are often the most odorous.

faq.q: What supplements help with IBD?
faq.a: IBD creates specific nutritional challenges that general supplements are not designed to address. Patients with ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease often experience malabsorption, increased nutrient losses, and elevated demands for specific vitamins and minerals due to chronic intestinal inflammation. The nutrients most commonly depleted in IBD include zinc, magnesium, vitamin D, iron, B12, and folate. Beyond micronutrients, IBD patients also benefit from targeted support for the gut lining, intestinal signaling pathways, and the microbiome. UltraInflamX Plus 360°® is a medical food specifically formulated to address these needs in a single daily serving, under healthcare practitioner supervision.*

faq.q: What is CurQfen and how is it different from regular curcumin?
faq.a: CurQfen is a patented curcumin-fenugreek complex developed to address one of the main limitations of standard curcumin: poor bioavailability. Standard curcumin extract is poorly absorbed in the gut, meaning most of what is consumed is never actually available for use by the body. CurQfen uses fenugreek-derived dietary fiber to significantly enhance curcumin absorption. A randomized double-blind crossover study demonstrated that CurQfen delivers up to 45.5x more free curcuminoids in human plasma compared to standard curcumin extract.* Research suggests curcumin may influence inflammatory signaling pathways including NF-kB and Nrf2, and may help support the body’s antioxidant defenses.* UltraInflamX Plus 360°® provides 500mg of CurQfen per daily dose.*

faq.q: What is xanthohumol and what does it do?
faq.a: Xanthohumol is a prenylated flavonoid found in hops (Humulus lupulus) and a Selective Kinase Response Modulator (SKRM). SKRMs work by influencing specific kinases and signaling molecules involved in the body’s inflammatory and oxidative stress responses, rather than broadly suppressing them. Research suggests xanthohumol may beneficially influence kinases and signaling molecules that affect intestinal comfort and function,* and demonstrates potent antioxidant activity through Nrf2 signaling pathways.* UltraInflamX Plus 360°® delivers xanthohumol via XNT ProMatrix, a proprietary protein matrix technology designed for enhanced bioavailability and stability.*

faq.q: Is UltraInflamX Plus 360°® suitable for ulcerative colitis?
faq.a: UltraInflamX Plus 360°® is a medical food formulated to meet the specialized nutritional needs of patients with IBD, and may be used with patients who have ulcerative colitis.* It is designed for use under the supervision of a healthcare practitioner as part of a targeted nutritional management plan. The formula addresses multiple aspects of IBD nutrition simultaneously: intestinal signaling support via CurQfen and xanthohumol, mucosal repair support via L-glutamine, prebiotic fiber via IMOs, and 20+ essential vitamins and minerals to address common nutrient gaps in IBD patients.* As with any medical food, it should be used alongside, not as a replacement for, your healthcare practitioner’s recommended treatment plan.

faq.q: Can I take UltraInflamX Plus 360°® for Crohn’s disease?
faq.a: UltraInflamX Plus 360°® is formulated to meet the specialized nutritional needs of patients with IBD, and may be used with patients who have Crohn’s disease.* Crohn’s disease is associated with significant nutritional challenges including protein-energy malnutrition, micronutrient deficiencies, and impaired absorption across multiple sections of the gastrointestinal tract. This formula addresses those challenges with 26g of plant-based protein, bioavailable forms of B12 and folate, zinc, vitamin D, and magnesium, alongside targeted gut support from CurQfen, xanthohumol, L-glutamine, and prebiotic IMOs.* Use under healthcare practitioner supervision as part of a broader Crohn’s disease management plan.

faq.q: How is UltraInflamX® Plus 360 different from UltraGI Replenish®?
faq.a: Both are Metagenics medical food powders designed for patients with compromised gut function, but they address different clinical situations. UltraGI Replenish® is formulated for general compromised gut function with digestive disorders and malabsorption. It features PreBiome 2’FL (HMO prebiotic), L-Alanyl-L-Glutamine for mucosal repair, and a comprehensive micronutrient profile to address nutrient gaps from malabsorption.* UltraInflamX Plus 360°® is formulated specifically for IBD, including ulcerative colitis and Crohn’s disease. faq.q: What is the difference between a B-complex supplement and B12?
faq.a: B12 is one of eight essential B vitamins, and is a common source of deficiency. B12 plays a critical role in energy production and nervous system health, but it’s just one in a whole family of eight B vitamins. A B-complex supplement provides all eight, supporting energy production, stress response, and homocysteine levels together. Some B-complex supplements feature nature-identical, activated forms, which are more readily available for your body to use.

faq.q: What does L-methylfolate do?
faq.a: L-methylfolate is the nature-identical, active form of folate (vitamin B9)—meaning it's ready for your body to use without conversion. Most conventional supplements use folic acid, which the body has to convert before it can be used. This step can be a barrier for those with genetic variations that affect folate conversion, such as MTHFR. Vitamin B-Complex features L-methylfolate alongside methylcobalamin B12. Other supplements, like Intrinsi B12-Folate™, also feature both nutrients in activated forms with added intrinsic factor for enhanced absorption.

How It Works

Vitamin D plays a critical role in multiple physiological systems. Once ingested, vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) is converted in the liver and kidneys into its active hormonal form, which helps regulate calcium and phosphorus balance in the body.

Bone Health: Vitamin D3 enhances intestinal absorption of calcium, a key mineral for maintaining bone density and skeletal integrity. Adequate vitamin D levels are essential for supporting strong bones and teeth.*
Immune Function: Vitamin D receptors are present on immune cells, underscoring its important role in supporting both innate and adaptive immune responses.*

faq.q: About Dr. Bridget Briggs, MD
faq.a: Dr. Bridget Briggs is a board-certified Family Medicine physician and Diplomate of the American Board of Family Medicine, specializing in weight management, hormone optimization, and epigenetic medicine. With over 20 years of clinical experience, she integrates evidence-based medicine with the science of genetics, nutrigenomics, and lifestyle medicine to deliver precise, personalized care. A graduate of UC San Diego School of Medicine, Dr. Briggs completed her Family Medicine residency at Riverside County Regional Medical Center and earned an Executive Master of Healthcare Administration (EMHA) from USC, along with advanced certifications through the AIHM, IFM, and a Master’s in Lipidology through the National Lipid Association. As founder of The Briggs Institute for Epigenetic Medicine in Temecula, California, Dr. Briggs develops targeted, evidence-based protocols that help patients restore metabolic balance, optimize hormones, and achieve lasting wellness through personalized, integrative care.

faq.q: About Dr. Bridget Briggs, MD
faq.a: Dr. Bridget Briggs is a board-certified Family Medicine physician and Diplomate of the American Board of Family Medicine, specializing in weight management, hormone optimization, and epigenetic medicine. With over 20 years of clinical experience, she integrates evidence-based medicine with the science of genetics, nutrigenomics, and lifestyle medicine to deliver precise, personalized care. A graduate of UC San Diego School of Medicine, Dr. Briggs completed her Family Medicine residency at Riverside County Regional Medical Center and earned an Executive Master of Healthcare Administration (EMHA) from USC, along with advanced certifications through the AIHM, IFM, and a Master’s in Lipidology through the National Lipid Association. As founder of The Briggs Institute for Epigenetic Medicine in Temecula, California, Dr. Briggs develops targeted, evidence-based protocols that help patients restore metabolic balance, optimize hormones, and achieve lasting wellness through personalized, integrative care.

faq.q: Who may benefit most from the women’s Precision Weight & Hormone Balance Stack?
faq.a: This protocol is designed for women ages 18–65 who struggle with stubborn or resistant weight loss, hormonal imbalance, or metabolic sluggishness often associated with stress, perimenopause, menopause, or insulin resistance. It’s ideal for individuals who feel “stuck” despite healthy eating and exercise, experience fatigue, mood fluctuations, or cravings, and are seeking a science-based, functional medicine approach to restore metabolic flexibility, gut health, and hormone harmony.

faq.q: What makes these products work better together?
faq.a: These products address the root causes of resistant weight loss by targeting multiple systems simultaneously nutrient sufficiency, gut integrity, hormone regulation, and metabolic signaling. Wellness Essentials provides foundational nutrient and omega support to optimize cellular function and reduce inflammation. TripleBiotic™ or UltraFlora® Control restore the gut microbiome, strengthening the intestinal barrier and support insulin response. Berberine GT™ amplifies these effects by activating AMPK, improving glucose and lipid metabolism, and supporting bile acid conversion. Together, they create a synergistic effect that improves metabolic flexibility, energy, and weight balance more effectively than any single intervention alone.

faq.q: What benefits can patients expect, and how soon?
faq.a: Most patients begin noticing increased energy, reduced bloating, and steadier mood within 2–4 weeks of starting this protocol. As gut balance and metabolic signaling improve, many also report clearer focus, better appetite control, and gradual fat loss—especially around the midsection. By 6–8 weeks, patients often experience measurable improvements in weight, insulin balance, and hormone regulation, along with a renewed sense of vitality. Continued use supports sustained metabolic flexibility, improved digestion, and long-term hormonal resilience.

faq.q: How should I take Precision Weight & Hormone Balance for Women?
faq.a: Take one Wellness Essentials packet each morning with breakfast to establish your nutrient foundation. Add one capsule of TripleBiotic™ or UltraFlora® Control daily to support gut balance and metabolism—this can be taken with or without food. Take one capsule of Berberine GT™ twice daily with meals (breakfast and dinner) for optimal blood sugar and lipid balance. To make adherence simple, keep all products together in a visible area and link them with daily habits such as morning hydration and mealtime routines. Consistency is key—regular use supports steady metabolic and hormonal improvements over time.

faq.q: Why do you recommend Precision Weight & Hormone Balance for Women in your practice?
faq.a: I recommend this protocol because it addresses the underlying metabolic and hormonal imbalances that often prevent patients from losing weight despite doing “everything right.” By combining foundational nutrients, microbiome support, and metabolic activators, this stack helps my patients rebalance inflammation, improve energy, and restore metabolic flexibility—often within just a few weeks. It’s one of the most effective and sustainable strategies I’ve used to help patients break through resistant weight loss while supporting their long-term hormone and gut health.
